concepts.label: coordinator (Search Service node acting as request coordinator)

relations.subject: service:search-service
relations.evidence: How the coordinator scatters the search request to all other search-index partitions (here, _Node 2_ and _Node 3_) in the cluster.

relations.subject: search:coordinator-node
relations.reused_or_minted_predicate: reused - extraction-layer (predicate used on search:coordinator-node's own promotion source page, but not itself among the 104 promoted predicates)
relations.evidence: When one particular Search Service node is chosen for a search request, it assumes the role of _coordinator_; and is thereby responsible for applying the search request to the other Search Service nodes and for gathering and returning results.

relations.subject: search:full-text-index
relations.evidence: The _Data Service_ uses the DCP protocol to stream data-mutations as batches, from the producer to multiple consumers (_vBuckets_), instantiated across the search nodes.

relations.subject: search:full-text-index
relations.reused_or_minted_predicate: minted - no existing predicate captures a search index partition's assignment of vBucket ranges; distinct from usesProtocol (the feed mechanism) and from any capacity/count predicate
relations.evidence: search-index data-handling for the vBuckets is divided equally among the established search-index partitions.
